messages.content: {"rule":"Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the passage of about 250 words that came immediately BEFORE the current text in its story.","text":"I can’t identify the passage immediately before this text because no story or source has been provided. The text doesn’t identify a work or establish what came before it, and inventing a passage would falsely present made-up material as part of a real story. Please provide the title, a link, or a longer excerpt containing the relevant section, and I can help locate the preceding passage."}
